panels.title: 🏆 全进程 CPU/GPU/内存/显存 Top 25（单进程采样口径）
panels.description: 最近60天保留逐进程明细（周边界可多留不足一周）；更早资源统计来自长期小时/北京时间日汇总，旧边界不足一小时按整小时统计。NULL表示缺测。 应用均值按每个有效进程样本加权；峰值是单进程样本峰值，不是多个PID合计峰值。整机曲线先逐采样时刻合计，再计算桶内均值。累计量沿既有速率×3.1秒估算，网络按连接占比分摊。IP和亲和性仅有近期明细。

targets.rawSql:
WITH fg_procs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT process_key, os_pid
  FROM public.fact_process_context
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '2 hours' AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    AND is_foreground = 1
),
bg_stats AS (
  SELECT
    a.process_key,
    ROUND(AVG(a.proc_cpu_usage)::numeric, 2) AS "CPU 均值 (%)",
    ROUND(MAX(a.proc_cpu_usage)::numeric, 2) AS "CPU 峰值 (%)",
    ROUND(AVG(a.proc_gpu_usage)::numeric, 2) AS "GPU 均值 (%)",
    ROUND(AVG(a.proc_ram_mb)::numeric, 0) AS "内存均值 (MB)",
    ROUND(AVG(a.proc_disk_read_rate_mb + a.proc_disk_write_rate_mb)::numeric, 2) AS "磁盘 IO (MB/s)",
    ROUND(AVG(a.proc_network_send_kb + a.proc_network_recv_kb)::numeric, 1) AS "网络 (KB/s)",
    COUNT(*) AS "后台采样数"
  FROM public.fact_process_activity a
  WHERE $__timeFilter(a."timestamp")
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM fg_procs f
      WHERE a.process_key = f.process_key AND a.os_pid = f.os_pid
    )
  GROUP BY a.process_key
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
)
SELECT
  r.process_name AS "后台内鬼进程",
  bs."CPU 均值 (%)",
  bs."CPU 峰值 (%)",
  bs."GPU 均值 (%)",
  bs."内存均值 (MB)",
  bs."磁盘 IO (MB/s)",
  bs."网络 (KB/s)",
  r.service_name AS "服务名",
  CASE WHEN r.signature_status = 1 THEN '✅ 已签名'
       WHEN r.signature_status = 0 THEN '⚠️ 未签名'
       ELSE '❓ 未知' END AS "签名状态",
  bs."后台采样数"
FROM bg_stats bs
JOIN public.dim_process_registry r ON bs.process_key = r.process_key
ORDER BY bs."CPU 均值 (%)" + bs."GPU 均值 (%)" + bs."内存均值 (MB)" / 1024.0 DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: 👿 后台内鬼榜 (is_foreground=0 静默高占用)（明细仅近60天）
panels.description: 最近60天保留逐进程明细（周边界可多留不足一周）；更早资源统计来自长期小时/北京时间日汇总，旧边界不足一小时按整小时统计。NULL表示缺测。 此面板需要PID、窗口关联或分钟级事件，超出明细保留范围不提供历史细节；空白不能解释为零活动或无异常。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT process_name AS "进程", executable_path AS "程序路径",
  ROUND((sum(active_proc_disk_read_rate_mb_sum) / NULLIF(sum(active_proc_disk_read_rate_mb_count),0))::numeric,3) AS "平均读速 (MB/s)", ROUND(max(active_proc_disk_read_rate_mb_max)::numeric,2) AS "峰值读速 (MB/s)", ROUND((sum(active_proc_disk_write_rate_mb_sum) / NULLIF(sum(active_proc_disk_write_rate_mb_count),0))::numeric,3) AS "平均写速 (MB/s)", ROUND(max(active_proc_disk_write_rate_mb_max)::numeric,2) AS "峰值写速 (MB/s)", ROUND((sum(active_proc_disk_iops_sum) / NULLIF(sum(active_proc_disk_iops_count),0))::numeric,0) AS "平均 IOPS", sum(active_proc_disk_write_rate_mb_sum)*3.1/1024.0 AS "累计写入 (GB)", sum(active_proc_disk_read_rate_mb_sum)*3.1/1024.0 AS "累计读取 (GB)", sum(disk_sample_count)::bigint AS "采样数"
FROM public.activity_app_stats($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz, CASE WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz >= interval '30 days' THEN 86400 ELSE 3600 END)
GROUP BY process_name, executable_path
HAVING sum(disk_sample_count) >= 2

) totals ORDER BY "累计写入 (GB)" + "累计读取 (GB)" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20;

targets.rawSql:
WITH totals AS (SELECT process_name AS "进程", executable_path AS "程序路径",
  ROUND((sum(active_proc_network_send_kb_sum) / NULLIF(sum(active_proc_network_send_kb_count),0))::numeric,1) AS "发送均速 (KB/s)", ROUND((sum(active_proc_network_recv_kb_sum) / NULLIF(sum(active_proc_network_recv_kb_count),0))::numeric,1) AS "接收均速 (KB/s)", (sum(active_proc_network_send_kb_sum)+sum(active_proc_network_recv_kb_sum))*3.1/1024.0 AS "累计流量 (MB)", max(active_proc_active_connections_max) AS "最大连接数", sum(network_sample_count)::bigint AS "采样数"
FROM public.activity_app_stats($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz, CASE WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz >= interval '30 days' THEN 86400 ELSE 3600 END)
GROUP BY process_name, executable_path
HAVING sum(network_sample_count) >= 2
ORDER BY "累计流量 (MB)" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20)
SELECT totals.*, (
 SELECT a.proc_remote_ip_port FROM public.fact_process_activity a
 JOIN public.dim_process_registry r USING(process_key)
 WHERE r.process_name=totals."进程" AND r.executable_path=totals."程序路径"
 AND a.timestamp >= GREATEST($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '2 hours')
 AND a.timestamp < $__timeTo()::timestamptz
 AND a.proc_remote_ip_port IS NOT NULL AND a.proc_remote_ip_port <> ''
 ORDER BY a.timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
) AS "最近远端 IP:Port" FROM totals ORDER BY "累计流量 (MB)" DESC NULLS LAST;

targets.rawSql:
WITH totals AS (SELECT process_name AS "进程", executable_path AS "程序路径",
  ROUND((sum(proc_thread_count_sum) / NULLIF(sum(proc_thread_count_count),0))::numeric,0) AS "平均线程数", ROUND(max(proc_thread_count_max)::numeric,0) AS "峰值线程数", ROUND((sum(proc_vram_shared_mb_sum) / NULLIF(sum(proc_vram_shared_mb_count),0))::numeric,0) AS "共享显存均值 (MB)", ROUND(max(proc_vram_shared_mb_max)::numeric,0) AS "共享显存峰值 (MB)", ROUND((sum(proc_vram_used_gb_sum) / NULLIF(sum(proc_vram_used_gb_count),0))::numeric,3) * 1024 AS "专用显存均值 (MB)", sum(sample_count)::bigint AS "采样数"
FROM public.activity_app_stats($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz, CASE WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz >= interval '30 days' THEN 86400 ELSE 3600 END)
GROUP BY process_name, executable_path
HAVING sum(sample_count) >= 3
ORDER BY "平均线程数" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20)
SELECT totals.*, (
 SELECT CASE WHEN max(a.proc_cpu_affinity) IS NULL THEN '无可用明细（仅近60天）'
 WHEN max(a.proc_cpu_affinity)=-1 THEN '全核 (所有 CPU)'
 ELSE 'mask=' || max(a.proc_cpu_affinity)::text END
 FROM public.fact_process_activity a JOIN public.dim_process_registry r USING(process_key)
 WHERE r.process_name=totals."进程" AND r.executable_path=totals."程序路径"
 AND a.timestamp >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND a.timestamp < $__timeTo()::timestamptz
) AS "CPU 亲和性" FROM totals ORDER BY "平均线程数" DESC NULLS LAST;

panels.title: 🧵 线程/亲和性/共享显存细览
panels.description: 最近60天保留逐进程明细（周边界可多留不足一周）；更早资源统计来自长期小时/北京时间日汇总，旧边界不足一小时按整小时统计。NULL表示缺测。 应用均值按每个有效进程样本加权；峰值是单进程样本峰值，不是多个PID合计峰值。整机曲线先逐采样时刻合计，再计算桶内均值。累计量沿既有速率×3.1秒估算，网络按连接占比分摊。IP和亲和性仅有近期明细。

targets.rawSql:
WITH time_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t_from,
    $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS t_to
),
-- 1. Identify which processes have ANY stuck event in the raw time range
stuck_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.process_key
  FROM public.fact_process_activity a
  CROSS JOIN time_bounds b
  WHERE a."timestamp" BETWEEN b.t_from AND b.t_to
    AND a.is_not_responding = 1
),
-- 2. Baseline running minutes (sampled to be fast) for these candidates
baseline_events AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('minute', a."timestamp") AS time_min,
    a.process_key,
    0 AS is_stuck
  FROM public.fact_process_activity a
  CROSS JOIN time_bounds b
  WHERE a."timestamp" BETWEEN b.t_from AND b.t_to
    AND a.process_key = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT process_key FROM stuck_candidates))
    AND (EXTRACT(second FROM a."timestamp")::int % 60) < 4
),
-- 3. Actual stuck events (unsampled, highly selective check on is_not_responding = 1)
actual_stuck_events AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('minute', a."timestamp") AS time_min,
    a.process_key,
    1 AS is_stuck
  FROM public.fact_process_activity a
  CROSS JOIN time_bounds b
  WHERE a."timestamp" BETWEEN b.t_from AND b.t_to
    AND a.is_not_responding = 1
),
-- 4. Combine baseline and stuck events, taking MAX(is_stuck)
combined_events AS (
  SELECT time_min, process_key, MAX(is_stuck) AS is_stuck
  FROM (
    SELECT time_min, process_key, is_stuck FROM baseline_events
    UNION ALL
    SELECT time_min, process_key, is_stuck FROM actual_stuck_events
  ) unioned
  GROUP BY time_min, process_key
),
-- 5. Filter sleep/shutdown minutes
filtered_events AS (
  SELECT
    ce.time_min AS time,
    ce.process_key,
    ce.is_stuck
  FROM combined_events ce
  CROSS JOIN time_bounds b
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.app_usage_logs l
    WHERE l.process_name IN ('System_Sleep', 'System_DisplayOff', 'LockApp.exe', 'System_Idle', 'Idle')
      AND ce.time_min >= l.start_time - interval '1 minute'
      AND ce.time_min <= l.start_time + (l.duration_seconds || ' seconds')::interval + interval '1 minute'
      AND l.start_time >= b.t_from - interval '1 day' AND l.start_time <= b.t_to AND l.start_time + (l.duration_seconds || ' seconds')::interval >= b.t_from
  )
),
-- 6. Identify processes that still have at least one stuck event AFTER filtering
final_stuck_processes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT process_key
  FROM filtered_events
  WHERE is_stuck = 1
)
-- 7. Final output: only processes with actual visible stuck events
SELECT
  fe.time,
  r.process_name AS metric,
  fe.is_stuck AS value
FROM filtered_events fe
JOIN public.dim_process_registry r ON fe.process_key = r.process_key
WHERE fe.process_key = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT process_key FROM final_stuck_processes))
UNION ALL
SELECT
  b.t_from AS time,
  CASE WHEN b.t_from < (SELECT raw_since FROM public.activity_retention_state WHERE singleton) THEN '⚪ 旧明细已汇总，无法判断历史卡死' ELSE '🟢 无卡死事件' END::text AS metric,
  0::int AS value
FROM time_bounds b
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM final_stuck_processes)
ORDER BY time ASC;

panels.title: 🔴 无响应卡死进程时间线 (红色:卡死 | 绿色:正常)（明细仅近60天）
panels.description: 最近60天保留逐进程明细（周边界可多留不足一周）；更早资源统计来自长期小时/北京时间日汇总，旧边界不足一小时按整小时统计。NULL表示缺测。 此面板需要PID、窗口关联或分钟级事件，超出明细保留范围不提供历史细节；空白不能解释为零活动或无异常。

targets.rawSql:
WITH time_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t_from,
    $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS t_to
),
-- 1. 先进行分钟级并使用 60s 抽样进行预聚合，大幅降低 I/O 和 CPU 负担
minutely_data AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('minute', a."timestamp") AS time_min,
    a.process_key,
    AVG(a.proc_ram_mb) AS avg_ram,
    AVG(COALESCE(a.proc_vram_used_gb, 0)) AS avg_vram
  FROM public.fact_process_activity a
  CROSS JOIN time_bounds b
  WHERE a."timestamp" BETWEEN b.t_from AND b.t_to
    AND (EXTRACT(second FROM a."timestamp")::int % 60) < 4
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
-- 2. 计算生命周期
process_lifespan AS (
  SELECT
    md.process_key,
    MIN(md.time_min) AS first_t,
    MAX(md.time_min) AS last_t,
    COUNT(*) AS samples
  FROM minutely_data md
  GROUP BY md.process_key
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 AND (MAX(md.time_min) - MIN(md.time_min)) >= interval '5 minutes'
),
-- 3. 计算趋势
process_mem_trend AS (
  SELECT
    pl.process_key,
    pl.samples,
    AVG(CASE WHEN md.time_min < pl.first_t + (pl.last_t - pl.first_t) * 0.1 THEN md.avg_ram END) AS mem_start,
    AVG(CASE WHEN md.time_min > pl.last_t - (pl.last_t - pl.first_t) * 0.1 THEN md.avg_ram END) AS mem_end,
    AVG(CASE WHEN md.time_min < pl.first_t + (pl.last_t - pl.first_t) * 0.1 THEN md.avg_vram END) AS vram_start,
    AVG(CASE WHEN md.time_min > pl.last_t - (pl.last_t - pl.first_t) * 0.1 THEN md.avg_vram END) AS vram_end
  FROM minutely_data md
  JOIN process_lifespan pl ON md.process_key = pl.process_key
  GROUP BY pl.process_key, pl.samples
)
SELECT
  r.process_name AS "进程名",
  ROUND(mem_start::numeric, 0) AS "起始内存 (MB)",
  ROUND(mem_end::numeric, 0) AS "结束内存 (MB)",
  ROUND((mem_end - mem_start)::numeric, 0) AS "内存增量 (MB)",
  CASE WHEN mem_start > 0 THEN ROUND(((mem_end - mem_start) / mem_start * 100)::numeric, 1) ELSE 0 END AS "内存增幅 (%)",
  ROUND(vram_start::numeric * 1024, 0) AS "起始显存 (MB)",
  ROUND(vram_end::numeric * 1024, 0) AS "结束显存 (MB)",
  ROUND((vram_end - vram_start)::numeric * 1024, 0) AS "显存增量 (MB)",
  samples AS "采样数"
FROM process_mem_trend pmt
JOIN public.dim_process_registry r ON pmt.process_key = r.process_key
WHERE mem_start IS NOT NULL AND mem_end IS NOT NULL
  AND (mem_end - mem_start) > 10
ORDER BY (mem_end - mem_start) DESC
LIMIT 15;

panels.title: 🧪 进程内存/显存泄漏嫌疑榜 (首末差值)（明细仅近60天）
panels.description: 最近60天保留逐进程明细（周边界可多留不足一周）；更早资源统计来自长期小时/北京时间日汇总，旧边界不足一小时按整小时统计。NULL表示缺测。 此面板需要PID、窗口关联或分钟级事件，超出明细保留范围不提供历史细节；空白不能解释为零活动或无异常。

targets.rawSql:
WITH time_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t_from,
    $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS t_to
),
time_grid AS (
  -- 【修复1】起点对齐到整分钟，否则 generate_series 带秒数，与下方 date_trunc('minute') 桶永不相等，前台联结全落空
  SELECT generate_series(
    date_trunc('minute', b.t_from),
    b.t_to,
    interval '1 minute'
  ) AS grid_time
  FROM time_bounds b
),
fg_keys AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (g.grid_time)
    g.grid_time AS time_min,
    ctx.process_key,
    ctx.os_pid
  FROM time_grid g
  JOIN public.fact_process_context ctx
    ON g.grid_time >= ctx."timestamp" AND (g.grid_time < ctx.end_timestamp OR ctx.end_timestamp IS NULL) AND ctx.is_foreground = 1 AND ctx.timestamp >= (SELECT t_from - interval '1 day' FROM time_bounds) AND ctx.timestamp <= (SELECT t_to FROM time_bounds)
  ORDER BY g.grid_time, ctx."timestamp" DESC
),
raw_activity AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('minute', a."timestamp") AS time_min,
    a.process_key,
    a.os_pid,
    SUM(a.proc_cpu_usage) AS sum_cpu,
    SUM(a.proc_gpu_usage) AS sum_gpu,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM public.fact_process_activity a
  CROSS JOIN time_bounds b
  WHERE a."timestamp" BETWEEN b.t_from AND b.t_to
    AND (EXTRACT(second FROM a."timestamp")::int % 60) < 4
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
per_min AS (
  -- 【修复2】每个(分钟,进程)先算该进程的均值 sum_cpu/cnt，再把前台那一个 / 后台所有进程分别求和；
  -- 旧写法 SUM(前台 cpu)/SUM(全部进程 cnt) 等于除以进程总数，前台(单进程)恒被稀释成≈0。
  SELECT
    ra.time_min,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fk.process_key IS NOT NULL THEN ra.sum_cpu / ra.cnt ELSE 0 END) AS fg_cpu,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fk.process_key IS NULL     THEN ra.sum_cpu / ra.cnt ELSE 0 END) AS bg_cpu,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fk.process_key IS NOT NULL THEN ra.sum_gpu / ra.cnt ELSE 0 END) AS fg_gpu,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fk.process_key IS NULL     THEN ra.sum_gpu / ra.cnt ELSE 0 END) AS bg_gpu
  FROM raw_activity ra
  LEFT JOIN fg_keys fk
    ON ra.time_min = fk.time_min
    AND ra.process_key = fk.process_key
    AND ra.os_pid = fk.os_pid
  GROUP BY ra.time_min
)
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(time_min, $__interval),
  ROUND(AVG(fg_cpu)::numeric, 2) AS "前台进程 CPU (%)",
  ROUND(AVG(bg_cpu)::numeric, 2) AS "后台总 CPU (%)",
  ROUND(AVG(fg_gpu)::numeric, 2) AS "前台进程 GPU (%)",
  ROUND(AVG(bg_gpu)::numeric, 2) AS "后台总 GPU (%)"
FROM per_min
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC;

panels.title: ⚔️ 前台 vs 后台资源争抢时序 (CPU/GPU)（明细仅近60天）
panels.description: 最近60天保留逐进程明细（周边界可多留不足一周）；更早资源统计来自长期小时/北京时间日汇总，旧边界不足一小时按整小时统计。NULL表示缺测。 此面板需要PID、窗口关联或分钟级事件，超出明细保留范围不提供历史细节；空白不能解释为零活动或无异常。

panels.title: 应用 CPU 趋势 · 小时/日均值与应用合计峰值

targets.rawSql:
WITH series AS (WITH points AS (
 SELECT * FROM public.activity_app_stats($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz,
 CASE WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz >= interval '30 days' THEN 86400 ELSE 3600 END)
), top_apps AS (
 SELECT process_name, executable_path FROM points GROUP BY process_name, executable_path
 ORDER BY sum(app_total_proc_cpu_usage_sum)/NULLIF(sum(app_total_proc_cpu_usage_count),0) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
), selected AS (SELECT p.* FROM points p JOIN top_apps USING(process_name,executable_path))
SELECT bucket_start AS time, process_name || ' · ' || executable_path || ' 应用合计均值' AS metric,
 sum(app_total_proc_cpu_usage_sum)/NULLIF(sum(app_total_proc_cpu_usage_count),0) AS value FROM selected
GROUP BY bucket_start,process_name,executable_path
UNION ALL
SELECT bucket_start, process_name || ' · ' || executable_path || ' 应用合计峰值', max(app_total_proc_cpu_usage_max)
FROM selected GROUP BY bucket_start,process_name,executable_path), ordered AS (
 SELECT *, lag(time) OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY time) AS previous_time FROM series
)
SELECT time, metric, value FROM series
UNION ALL
SELECT previous_time + (CASE WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz >= interval '30 days' THEN interval '1 day' ELSE interval '1 hour' END), metric, NULL::double precision FROM ordered
WHERE time > previous_time + (CASE WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz >= interval '30 days' THEN interval '1 day' ELSE interval '1 hour' END) ORDER BY time;

panels.description: 按应用名和路径区分，先把同一采样时刻的各PID资源相加，再统计小时/日的应用合计均值和峰值；每项指标按有效采样时刻加权。所选期间均值最高10个应用。缺测保留NULL断线，不补零；日段按日、小时段按小时。
